question: Which presiding principles govern the ranges ending with person and with māyā?
premises: One range extends from earth up to person.
Another range extends up to māyā from kādi.
Each range has a presiding principle.
inference: Brahmā presides over the range up to person, and Acyuta presides over the range up to māyā.
uncertainties: The technical cosmological boundaries implied by kādi and pum are context-dependent.
plain_english: Brahmā presides up to the range from earth to person, and Acyuta up to the range ending with māyā.
